up-git: parts, licences and where the source is

Part                            Licence                       Source
------------------------------  ----------------------------  ----------------------------------------
git (bin/git, share/git-core)   GPL-2.0-only (licenses/git)   upterm-ports (pkgs/git; git 2.56.0, kernel.org)

Notes
- The complete source with UP-Term's patches and build recipes is up-term-src.lha, published next to
  up-term.lha. Its row of SOURCES.txt is in UP-Term:licenses/git/SOURCES.txt.
